Open-choice CLI requirement: Revit 2025, Archicad 27, and Abaqus 2025 are available at the paths listed above. Choose an appropriate tool and its command-line or official automation workflow from these three to edit C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and save the completed model deliverable into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside the selected tool workflow. The current model is a long single-storey training suite with too little functional definition. The operator wants a foyer, two classrooms, and a store arranged as a clear sequence while keeping the simple strip-building footprint.
